title: docs(skills): a zoned date bucket stays in memory only where the driver cannot bucket that zone
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34597

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：查询技能 `aggregation.md` 里一句话，原来说「非 UTC 时区的日期分桶会让整次聚合在内存里算」，现在改成：声明了 `supports.zonedDateBucketing` 的驱动（目前只有 driver-sql 的 PostgreSQL）在时区能解析成地区/城市名时直接在库里分桶；其它驱动、以及 `+08:00`、`EST5EDT` 这类解析不出地区的时区，仍整次在内存里算。另加一条 eval。
- 为什么改：#33697 合并后 PostgreSQL 已经在库里算带时区的分桶，旧句子对 PG 是错的，AI 读技能会对性能和 `aggregationFilter` 行为做出错误判断。
- 风险与回滚：只改对外发布的技能文字和 eval，不动代码；回滚就是还原这一个 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md` 第 127–131 行（新句子），`skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` 的 eval 9，`.changeset/34597-skills-zoned-date-bucket.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期看到 `aggregation.md is 2346 tokens (ceiling 2357; headroom 11)` 且整体通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（`skills/**` 属受治理面，按其档位记录落地）。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md`, section "Filtered Aggregation (FILTER WHERE)": the parenthetical that said a date bucket under a non-UTC `timezone` keeps the whole call in memory now matches the merged engine.

- Old: "(a date bucket under a non-UTC `timezone`, or one the driver does not bucket natively, keeps the whole call in memory)"
- New: "(a date bucket the driver does not bucket natively keeps the whole call in memory; so does one under a non-UTC `timezone`, unless the driver declares `supports.zonedDateBucketing` — PostgreSQL via `driver-sql` — and the zone resolves to an area/location: `Asia/Taipei` buckets in the database, `+08:00` or `EST5EDT` never)"

Sources, read at `origin/main` 444301463: `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts` lines 1435–1459 (`judgeBucketZone`, `zoneNative`, `tzRequiresInMemory`, which gates `nativeAggregate` at line 1488) and `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` line 409 (`zonedDateBucketing: this.isPostgres`).

`skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json`: new eval case 9 (monthly revenue on Taipei calendar months with a filtered count; PostgreSQL vs SQLite vs `+08:00`). No earlier case exercised the sentence.

`.changeset/34597-skills-zoned-date-bucket.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, the same shape as the earlier skills-text notes.

## Why

#33697 (ADR-0053 Phase 2 D2 as amended, maintainer ruling 「PG 在库里算，修订 ADR」) made PostgreSQL bucket a zoned date in the database. The skill still told authors and agents the whole call runs in memory, which is false on PostgreSQL for an area/location zone.

## Tests

No code changed, so there is no unit test or ablation. Eval check by script at head 2555c75f7: case ids 1–9 distinct; every `must_contain` of every case appears in its `expected_output`; no `must_not_contain` appears in it (0 violations).

Skills readings (lines): `aggregation.md` 272 → 275; eval file 85 → 95 (unpriced, population 1b); sum of all `SKILL.md` 4730 → 4730 (unchanged); all `skills/**/*.md` 18128 → 18131. Tokens: `aggregation.md` 2292 → 2346 against ceiling 2357 (headroom 11), paid from existing headroom; no ceiling row moved.

## Acceptance notes

- `dispatch-gates --tier` derives a mandatory contract-review authoring tier for `skills/**`. The claim's `Container & model` line records `TIER_DEFAULT`, and this run was served at that tier, so this body carries no `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` line. The seat decides the review route.
- Grepped `skills/objectstack-query/**` (SKILL.md, rules, references) for the same claim: no other sentence says a zoned bucket always stays in memory. `rules/aggregation.md` § Date-Bucketed Grouping does not mention `timezone` at all; it is not the same false claim and is left as is.
- Observation, not filed: `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` (Date-bucketed grouping callout) says the SQL driver ignores a structured `groupBy` `alias`, while the skill says results are correct either way "including the column keys". Not measured on a public door; outside this card's file surface.

## Fix round 2 (seat contract review 6963664711)

- S1 (should-fix): eval case 9's `must_not_contain` held `timezone: '+08:00'`. The case's own prompt asks about passing `+08:00`, and the grader matches substrings, so a correct answer restating it as code would fail. Dropped that one token; `must_not_contain` is now `["date_trunc"]`. `must_contain` (`timezone: 'Asia/Taipei'`, `in memory`, the rest) and N1/N2 are unchanged; `aggregation.md` is unchanged.
- Head 6465f93e2.
